product: Trailnote — field observations for volunteer conservation teams
audience: Volunteers recording sightings outdoors with unreliable connectivity
primary_task: Record a sighting with a note and optional photo, then understand its sync status
scope: Observation list, add observation, local save state, simulated sync failure and retry
stack: Use the existing mobile framework; if absent, state a minimal platform choice
direction: Practical field notebook with high readability, natural color cues and clear status labels; avoid decorative nature imagery behind controls
constraints: No claim of remote sync without a backend
acceptance: A new sighting can be recorded without a photo or connection
The keyboard does not hide the note field or save action
Large text and assistive labels preserve the main journey
Locally saved, syncing, failed, and synced are distinct and truthful
The chosen simulator/device and unverified hardware integrations are documented
